title: Lightroom Export Photo Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightroom:photo
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by collection_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Lightroom export photo data has stopped arriving for a given collection name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per collection name and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your Lightroom export photo feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
